title: Nie Xiaoqian
synopsis: This is the first part of our rendition of Pu SongLing’s short story “Nie Xiaoqian”.

fullText.simplified:
小倩（一）

    金华最近死了很多人，而且他们死得很奇怪。死者身上没有一个伤口，只有脚心有一个小孔，像是被锥子刺过的一样。金华的人都很害怕，很多人都搬走了。
    宁采臣来到金华办事。他想找个旅馆住下，但找了很久，竟然没有一个旅馆开门。他走到郊外，看到一座寺庙。那座寺庙虽然很大，但院子里长满了和人一样高的草，看上去已经很久没有人住了。走进寺庙，他看到这座寺庙东西两面的房间的门都开着，只有南面的一间小屋关着门，上面挂着一把锁。
    宁采臣很喜欢这个安静的地方，于是他决定暂时住在这里。他一边看书，一边等南面小屋的主人回来。
    吃过晚饭后，宁采臣看到有个书生走进寺庙，打开了南面小屋的门锁。他连忙走过去打招呼：“您好！我叫宁采臣。今天来金华办事，路过这座寺庙，想借住在这里，不知是否方便？”
    那个书生说：“您好您好！我叫燕赤霞。这座寺庙已经很久没有人来了。我也是个借住的人。你要是喜欢这里，就住下来吧！”
    宁采臣很高兴，找了一间空房间，住了下来。
    晚上，宁采臣因为认床，怎么也睡不着。到了半夜，他突然感觉到有人走进他的房间。
    宁采臣赶紧坐了起来，只见房里站着一个非常漂亮的年轻女子。
    他很吃惊，忙问：“你是谁？进来干什么？”
    女子笑着说：“公子别紧张。我叫小倩，就住在附近。现在月色正好，我想来陪陪公子。”
    宁采臣很认真地说：“我不要你陪！夜色已深。一男一女在房间里，你不怕别人说闲话，我还怕呢。你快回去吧！”
    小倩站着没动，“这里很少有人来，又那么晚了，不会有人知道的。”她说。
    宁采臣大声骂道：“快走开！要不然我就要喊南面屋里的人了！”
    听了这话，小倩似乎有些害怕，转身离开了。但到了屋外，她又转了回来，在宁采臣的被子上放了一块金子。宁采臣拿起金子直接扔到了门外，又骂道：“来路不明的金子，只会脏了我的口袋。”
    小倩没办法，只好离开了。
    第二天一大早，又有两个书生借住寺庙。谁知，当天夜里，一个书生突然死了。他的身上没有一个伤口，只有脚心有一个小孔，像是被锥子刺的，还有血从那小孔里流出来。又过了一个晚上，另一个书生也死了，和前一个书生一样，脚心也有一个被锥子刺的小孔。
（未完待续）
fullText.traditional:
小倩（一）

    金華最近死了很多人，而且他們死得很奇怪。死者身上沒有一個傷口，只有腳心有一個小孔，像是被錐子刺過的一樣。金華的人都很害怕，很多人都搬走了。
    寧采臣來到金華辦事。他想找個旅館住下，但找了很久，竟然沒有一個旅館開門。他走到郊外，看到一座寺廟。那座寺廟雖然很大，但院子裡長滿了和人一樣高的草，看上去已經很久沒有人住了。走進寺廟，他看到這座寺廟東西兩面的房間的門都開著，只有南面的一間小屋關著門，上面掛著一把鎖。
    寧采臣很喜歡這個安靜的地方，於是他決定暫時住在這裡。他一邊看書，一邊等南面小屋的主人回來。
    吃過晚飯後，寧采臣看到有個書生走進寺廟，打開了南面小屋的門鎖。他連忙走過去打招呼：“您好！我叫寧采臣。今天來金華辦事，路過這座寺廟，想借住在這裡，不知是否方便？”
    那個書生說：“您好您好！我叫燕赤霞。這座寺廟已經很久沒有人來了。我也是個借住的人。你要是喜歡這裡，就住下來吧！”
    寧采臣很高興，找了一間空房間，住了下來。
    晚上，寧采臣因為認床，怎麼也睡不著。到了半夜，他突然感覺到有人走進他的房間。
    寧采臣趕緊坐了起來，只見房裡站著一個非常漂亮的年輕女子。
    他很吃驚，忙問：“你是誰？進來幹什麼？”
    女子笑著說：“公子別緊張。我叫小倩，就住在附近。現在月色正好，我想來陪陪公子。”
    寧采臣很認真地說：“我不要你陪！夜色已深。一男一女在房間裡，你不怕別人說閒話，我還怕呢。你快回去吧！”
    小倩站著沒動，“這裡很少有人來，又那麼晚了，不會有人知道的。”她說。
    寧采臣大聲罵道：“快走開！要不然我就要喊南面屋裡的人了！”
    聽了這話，小倩似乎有些害怕，轉身離開了。但到了屋外，她又轉了回來，在寧采臣的被子上放了一塊金子。寧采臣拿起金子直接扔到了門外，又罵道：“來路不明的金子，只會髒了我的口袋。”
    小倩沒辦法，只好離開了。
    第二天一大早，又有兩個書生借住寺廟。誰知，當天夜裡，一個書生突然死了。他的身上沒有一個傷口，只有腳心有一個小孔，像是被錐子刺的，還有血從那小孔裡流出來。又過了一個晚上，另一個書生也死了，和前一個書生一樣，腳心也有一個被錐子刺的小孔。
（未完待續）

sentences.english: Ning Caichen picked up the gold and immediately threw it out the door, and scolded her again:

sentences.simplified: “来路不明的金子，只会脏了我的口袋。”
sentences.traditional: “來路不明的金子，只會髒了我的口袋。”
sentences.pinyin: lái lù bù míng de jīn zi zhǐ huì zāng le wǒ de kǒu dài
sentences.english: “Gold no-one knows where it came from, will only dirty my pocket.”

sentences.simplified: 小倩没办法，只好离开了。
sentences.traditional: 小倩沒辦法，只好離開了。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo qiàn méi bàn fǎ zhǐ hǎo lí kāi le
sentences.english: Xiao Qian was out of options, so she had to leave.

sentences.simplified: 第二天一大早，又有两个书生借住寺庙。
sentences.traditional: 第二天一大早，又有兩個書生借住寺廟。
sentences.pinyin: dì èr tiān yí dà zǎo yòu yǒu liǎng ge shū shēng jiè zhù sì miào
sentences.english: First thing in the morning the next day, two more scholars lodged at the temple.

sentences.simplified: 谁知，当天夜里，一个书生突然死了。
sentences.traditional: 誰知，當天夜裡，一個書生突然死了。
sentences.pinyin: shéi zhī dàng tiān yè li yí ge shū shēng tū rán sǐ le
sentences.english: Who would have thought, that during the same night, one scholar suddenly died.

sentences.simplified: 他的身上没有一个伤口，只有脚心有一个小孔，
sentences.traditional: 他的身上沒有一個傷口，只有腳心有一個小孔，
sentences.pinyin: tā de shēn shang méi yǒu yí ge shāng kǒu zhǐ yǒu jiǎo xīn yǒu yí ge xiǎo kǒng
sentences.english: There wasn’t a wound on his body, only a small hole in the arch of his foot, ..

sentences.simplified: 像是被锥子刺的，还有血从那小孔里流出来。
sentences.traditional: 像是被錐子刺的，還有血從那小孔裡流出來。
sentences.pinyin: xiàng shì bèi zhuī zi cì de hái yǒu xiě cóng nà xiǎo kǒng lǐ liú chū lái
sentences.english: .. like he had been pricked by an awl, and there was blood flowing from that small hole.

sentences.simplified: 又过了一个晚上，另一个书生也死了，和前一个书生一样，
sentences.traditional: 又過了一個晚上，另一個書生也死了，和前一個書生一樣，
sentences.pinyin: yòu guò le yí ge wǎn shang lìng yí ge shū shēng yě sǐ le hé qián yí ge shū shēng yí yàng
sentences.english: Another night went by, and the other scholar also died, in the same way as the earlier scholar.

sentences.simplified: 脚心也有一个被锥子刺的小孔。
sentences.traditional: 腳心也有一個被錐子刺的小孔。
sentences.pinyin: jiǎo xīn yě yǒu yí ge bèi zhuī zi cì de xiǎo kǒng
sentences.english: The arch of his foot also had a small hole of an awl’s prick.

sentences.simplified: （未完待续）
sentences.traditional: （未完待續）
sentences.pinyin: wèi wán dài xù
sentences.english: (To be continued)

raw.synopsis: This is the first part of our rendition of Pu SongLing’s short story “Nie Xiaoqian”.
sentence_translations: Xiao Qian (Part 1)
A lot of people recently died in Jinhua, but they also died very strangely.
The deceased didn’t have wounds on their bodies, they only had a small hole in the arch of their foot, ..
.. as if they had been pricked by an awl.
Everyone in Jinhua was very scared, a lot of people had moved away.
Ning Caichen had come to Jinhua to work.
He wanted to look for a hotel to stay at, but after looking for a very long time, ..
.. to his surprise, there weren't any hotels open.
He walked to the outskirts and saw a temple.
Although the temple was very large, inside the courtyard it was overgrown with grass as tall as a person.
It would appear that no one had lived there for a very long time already.
Entering the temple, he noticed that all the room doors on both the eastern and western sides of this temple were open.
Only a small room on the south side had its door closed, and a lock was hanging on it.
Ning Caichen liked this calm place very much, so he decided to stay here for the time being.
While reading, he waited for the master of the small southern room to come back.
After he finished eating dinner, Ning Caichen saw a scholar walking into the temple, ..
.. and opening the door lock of the small southern room.
He promptly walked over to greet him:
“Hello! I am Ning Caichen. I arrived in Jinhua today for work, passed by this temple, and want to lodge here.”
I don't know whether or not that’s convenient?
That scholar said:
“Hello hello! I am Yan Chixia. No one has come to this temple for a very long time already.”
“I am also a lodger. If you like it here, then come and stay!”
Ning Caichen was very happy, looked for an empty room, and settled in.
In the evening, because Ning Caichen had trouble sleeping in an unfamiliar bed, he was unable to sleep at all.
At midnight, he suddenly felt that someone walked into his room.
Ning Caichen hurriedly sat up, only to see that an extremely beautiful young woman was standing in the room.
He was very shocked, and hurriedly asked: “Who are you? What are you doing in here?”
The woman said smilingly: “Son of an official, don’t be nervous. I am Xiao Qian, and live nearby.”
“At the moment the moonlight is just right. I wanted to come and keep you company, son of an official.”
Ning Caichen said very seriously:
“I don't want your company! It’s deep in the night.”
“A man and a woman in a room. You’re not afraid what gossip other people will say, but I'm afraid. Quickly go back!”
Xiao Qian stood without moving.
“Very few people come here, and it’s also so late. No one will know,” she said.
Ning Caichen scolded her in a loud voice:
“Leave quickly! Or else I’ll call for the person inside the southern room!”
Hearing this, Xiao Qian seemed a bit scared, turned around and left.
But when she got outside the room, she turned back around again and put a piece of gold on Ning Caichen’s quilt.
Ning Caichen picked up the gold and immediately threw it out the door, and scolded her again:
“Gold no-one knows where it came from, will only dirty my pocket.”
Xiao Qian was out of options, so she had to leave.
First thing in the morning the next day, two more scholars lodged at the temple.
Who would have thought, that during the same night, one scholar suddenly died.
There wasn’t a wound on his body, only a small hole in the arch of his foot, ..
.. like he had been pricked by an awl, and there was blood flowing from that small hole.
Another night went by, and the other scholar also died, in the same way as the earlier scholar.
The arch of his foot also had a small hole of an awl’s prick.
(To be continued)
